Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walking sprite sheet for the established native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1 is the exact APPEARANCE, PROPORTIONS and COLOR master. Input 2 is a different cultist used ONLY as MOVEMENT guide. Do not copy the cultist's clothes or human body.
Subject: The exact SMALL bat-winged demon from the appearance master: short reddish-brown body, small angular dark face and two swept reddish horns/long pointed ears, dull ochre-gold chest plating, short thick two legs with dark clawed feet, TWO arms, TWO dark charcoal bat wings sloping DOWN beside the body. Keep its small compact build and down-carried wing shape; wingspan roughly 1.2 times full figure height. Never enlarge it into the tall muscular demon used elsewhere. No weapon, new armor, tail or extra appendages.
Primary task: redraw ONLY the locomotion, preserving original identity, proportions, scale, clothing, body construction and all material colors. Match master colors and dark shading closely: NO lightening, pinkening, whitening or stronger highlights in walking poses. The same fixed game illumination is used at rest and in movement; never paint extra light on the moving figure.
Direction: true FRONT view walking SOUTH/DOWN toward viewer in all eight walking cells, same slightly elevated native game projection.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 columns × 3 rows, equal square cells, row-major order, eight distinct walking poses plus ninth relaxed front idle. All nine figures COMPLETE, including horns, wingtips, fingers and feet; generous transparent margins and no inter-cell overlap or clipping. Same scale across every cell, camera and rigid body size constant.
Animation: first eight cells are ONE seamless two-step cycle. 1 LEFT foot reaches contact, right trails; 2 weight settles over planted left support; 3 RIGHT foot passes close underneath hip with LOW knee lift; 4 right reaches next contact; 5 opposite/right foot contact; 6 weight settles on planted right; 7 LEFT foot passes underneath hip; 8 left reaches next contact to repeat cell1. Eight DISTINCT meaningful phases. Quiet compact forward/back steps, no side-splaying, scissor gait, high knees or dancing. Exactly 400ms each step, 800ms full cycle. Preserve each creature's weight and natural bent legs.
GROUND locomotion: wings stay attached at shoulder blades and steady for balance; never flap or fly. Feet are the supports. Head remains connected firmly to torso with minimal bob; torso, arms and wings move coherently. No detached parts, band shifts, sheared limbs or grafted legs.
Style: exactly the appearance master's dark native pixel-art style, readable deliberate clusters and sharp edges at 42px final figure height. NOT a smooth HD painting, no blur, airbrush, grain, glossy recolor or added rim light. No new effects. Background genuinely transparent alpha ZERO, including holes between limbs and wings. NO floor, cast shadow, matte, checkerboard, grid lines, text, labels, borders or other characters.
